SELECT enabled, channel_order, hours_before, default_country_code, wa_phone_number_id, (COALESCE(wa_token, '') <> '') AS has_wa_token, wa_template_name, wa_template_lang,
  sms_provider, (COALESCE(sms_api_key, '') <> '') AS has_sms_key, sms_sender, sms_template FROM messaging_settings WHERE id = 1;

UPDATE messaging_settings SET
  enabled = COALESCE($1::boolean, enabled), channel_order = COALESCE($2, channel_order), hours_before = COALESCE($3::int[], hours_before),
  default_country_code = COALESCE($4, default_country_code), wa_phone_number_id = COALESCE($5, wa_phone_number_id),
  wa_token = CASE WHEN $6::boolean THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE($7, wa_token) END, wa_template_name = COALESCE($8, wa_template_name), wa_template_lang = COALESCE($9, wa_template_lang),
  sms_api_key = CASE WHEN $10::boolean THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE($11, sms_api_key) END, sms_sender = COALESCE($12, sms_sender), sms_template = COALESCE($13, sms_template), updated_at = now()
WHERE id = 1 RETURNING id;

SELECT r.id, r.activity_id, r.hours_before, r.channel, r.status, r.detail, r.created_at, a.subject, a.due_at, TRIM(CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name)) AS client
FROM appointment_reminders r JOIN activities a ON a.id = r.activity_id LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = a.contact_id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 40;

SELECT row_to_json(m) AS cfg, (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) AS company_name, (SELECT COALESCE(timezone, 'UTC') FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) AS tz, (SELECT time_format FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) AS tf FROM messaging_settings m WHERE m.id = 1;

WITH cfg AS (SELECT * FROM messaging_settings WHERE id = 1 AND enabled = true),
cand AS (
  SELECT a.id AS activity_id, h AS hours_before, a.due_at, a.subject, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.phone, sm.name AS staff_name, u.location AS branch
  FROM cfg
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(cfg.hours_before) AS h
  JOIN activities a ON a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND a.type <> 'task' AND a.is_completed = false AND a.outcome IS NULL
    AND a.due_at > now() AND a.due_at <= now() + make_interval(hours => h)
    AND a.created_at <= a.due_at - make_interval(hours => h)
  JOIN contacts c ON c.id = a.contact_id AND c.is_archived = false AND COALESCE(c.phone, '') <> '' AND c.do_not_contact = false AND c.dnc_sms = false
  LEFT JOIN staff_members sm ON sm.id = a.staff_id
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_reminders r WHERE r.activity_id = a.id AND r.hours_before = h)
  ORDER BY a.due_at LIMIT 40
), ranked AS (
  SELECT cand.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cand.activity_id ORDER BY cand.hours_before ASC) AS rn FROM cand
), claimed AS (
  -- If several reminder times are already due for the same booking (for example the system was just switched on), only the closest one is sent.
  INSERT INTO appointment_reminders (activity_id, hours_before, status, detail)
  SELECT activity_id, hours_before, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'sending' ELSE 'skipped' END, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN NULL ELSE 'A closer reminder was sent instead.' END FROM ranked
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id, activity_id, hours_before, status
)
SELECT claimed.id AS reminder_id, cand.*, (SELECT row_to_json(cfg) FROM cfg) AS cfg,
  (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) AS company_name,
  (SELECT COALESCE(timezone, 'UTC') FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) AS tz,
  (SELECT time_format FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) AS tf
FROM claimed JOIN cand ON cand.activity_id = claimed.activity_id AND cand.hours_before = claimed.hours_before WHERE claimed.status = 'sending';
UPDATE appointment_reminders SET status = $2, channel = $3, detail = $4, sent_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int;
